scope: Extend the configured screened-transport minimum from130kK to100kK for the current H-rich cooling envelope. Same fully stripped transport equations; trace-helium charge uncertainty retained.
limitation: Partial helium ionization makes trace-He3 clearing time uncertain; fully stripped diffusion is an approximation. The GMm/R value is an energy scale, not a rigorous bound on sinking to the centre. No accuracy claim for the final trace-He abundance.
